Description: PharmaSuite auto-fires ProcessRecordedException on creation of a qualifying exception; the agent must consume it without any manual trigger-selection step by the operator.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Given a qualifying exception (at/above the agreed risk-class threshold) is created in PharmaSuite, when PharmaSuite auto-fires ProcessRecordedException, then the message is consumed with no operator trigger-selection step.
- Given the Exception module or its inference capability is unavailable when the trigger fires, when PharmaSuite attempts to fire, then the exception remains in PharmaSuite's standard review workflow, unaffected and without an operator-visible error.
- Given a duplicate ProcessRecordedException is redelivered, when the Queue Consumer processes it, then the idempotency check prevents a second exception record from being created.

Summary: Build on-prem AMQP 1.0 connector (ActiveMQ to Amazon SQS republish)
Description: Picks messages off PharmaSuite's ActiveMQ and republishes each into Amazon SQS exception-in via SQS's own API.

Summary: Build SQS Queue Consumer (idempotency check, deserialize, validate)
Description: Consumes Amazon SQS exception-in using ReceiveMessage in a loop and hands validated payloads to the orchestrator.
Every ingested exception must carry its originating site and route through Archetype Resolution; unmatched combinations must not fail silently.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given an incoming exception payload, when it is ingested, then it is tagged with its originating site (Andover, Grange Castle DP, or Sanford) and ORDER_NUMBER.
- Given an exception whose exception_type + risk_class combination has no matching archetype, when archetype Resolution runs, then it is routed to the no-archetype-match fallback instead of failing silently.

Description: No manual re-entry step once guardrails pass and the operator authenticates.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a Guardrail-passed, authenticated, submitted draft, when the Write-Back Formatter runs, then it performs an idempotency check, writes the final exception record, and publishes to the outbound queue.
- Given the Write-Back message reaches PharmaSuite, when ConfirmRecordedException is received, then PharmaSuite appends it as a comment and updates exception status automatically.

Description: Idempotency check plus final exceptions write before publishing outbound.

Summary: Implement Amazon SQS exception-out with DLQ
Description: Outbound queue for approved, formatted write-back messages.
Republishes outbound SQS messages back onto PharmaSuite's ActiveMQ.
Notifies a Teams/Email webhook subscriber when an exception can't be matched to an archetype.
